rows.label: tlk47300169_01_msg0001
rows.name:
You can get to Superbia from Rijite
Port, and there's a regular service to
Acedia here at Port Isheba.

rows.label: tlk47300169_01_msg0002
rows.name:
They call it a regular service, but
without enough cargo, departure can be
delayed while they wait for more.

rows.label: tlk47300169_01_msg0004
rows.name:
We really need a proper regular
service. Waiting is hard too.
